# Dr. Lane Odom — The Pickleball Chiro

> Pickleball performance coach and Doctor of Chiropractic. Helps players find and fix the specific leak keeping them stuck at a low rating — in person across Daytona Beach, Ormond Beach, New Smyrna Beach, Port Orange, and Edgewater, FL, and virtually anywhere. 4.7 DUPR, 13+ years of racket sports experience.

## Work With Me
- [Virtual Coaching (Crestline)](https://www.gocrestline.app/coaches/lane-odom): Game film review, custom drill programming, and weekly accountability — available anywhere.
- [In-Person Pickleball Lessons](https://pickleballchiro.co/lessons/): 1-on-1 sessions in the East Volusia County, FL area.
- [Mobile Chiropractic Care](https://pickleballchiro.co/): Chiropractic and rehab care that comes to you in East Volusia County, FL.
